title: id -u returns 0 inside Cursor's Linux sandbox, so docker --user and chown use root
symptoms: Files created by a sandboxed Docker run are owned by root on the host
$(id -u) and $UID print 0 in Agent terminal commands
cause: On Linux the sandbox runs commands in a user namespace remapped to UID 0, so scripts that read the current user ID get root inside the sandbox.
fix: Read the host IDs from CURSOR_ORIG_UID and CURSOR_ORIG_GID, falling back to id when they are unset.
affected: Cursor Agent sandbox on Linux (Landlock, kernel 6.2 or later), as of 2026-10
